glosses: fan, supporter, hobbyist (person who likes and supports a sports team or an athlete very much)

examples.text: Él se quedó en el hotel la mayor parte del día siguiente, hablando con sus amigos y seguidores.
examples.en: He stayed in his hotel most of the next day, talking to friends and supporters.

examples.text: El seguidor del Islam se llama musulmán.
examples.en: A person who follows Islam is known as a Muslim.

examples.text: Alguno de los seguidores de Martin luther King enpezaron a cuestionar su creencia en las protestas pacíficas.
examples.en: Some of Martin Luther King's supporters began to question his belief in peaceful protests.
